## Goal
Every call produces live events and a stored transcript the rest of the system relies on.

## Owns
- `engines/livekit-agent/src/frontdesk/events.py`
- `engines/livekit-agent/tests/test_events.py`

## Tests first (write them, see them fail, then implement)
- call.started/ended envelopes match contracts/events; correlationId = call id.
- transcript.partial throttled to 2/s; transcript uploaded before call.ended is published.

## Steps
- boto3 PutEvents and S3 put; retries; never block the audio path.
